{{dablink|For other uses of the word "water," see [[Water (disambiguation)|Water]].}}
The '''Bitter Water''' is a sept of the [[Taardad]] [[Aiel]]. The sept hold is unknown.
== Trivia ==
* In earlier versions of ''The Wheel of Time'', [[Aviendha]] was listed as belonging to the Bitter Water sept, though this was later corrected and changed to the [[Nine Valleys]] sept.
